_doc: Engine wrap column count per ELF string key range [lo, hi) (hex file offsets). Single-line Japanese longer than N is engine-wrapped at N full-width columns; Korean is pre-wrapped at N cells (half-width units 0.5) so the engine never re-wraps it. 'verified' marks values observed in PCSX2.
ranges: skill descriptions (Japanese pads lines with full-width spaces to 13)
equipment traits / growbook effects (ja breaks explicitly at 12; unverified)
item memo window: 11 full-width columns x 5 lines (verified in PCSX2, item menu)
student handbook memo / status lines: ja breaks lines at 13 columns (unverified in game)
character diaries (ja breaks lines at 18 columns)
growbook cards / titles (title text breaks at 16)
help pages: ja breaks at 21 columns, 5 lines per page
_doc_lists: list_width: [lo, hi, W, note] -- entries shown in the same window/list; a Korean entry may use up to W cells (the widest Japanese entry of the list). Applies to {F1}-prefixed names when the range also has an engine wrap width.
list_width: class/assignment objective lines (unverified; ja up to ~21)
_doc_lines: max_lines: [lo, hi, L, note] -- window capacity in lines; a translation may use up to max(L, Japanese line count) lines.
max_lines: equipment trait descriptions (ja up to 3 explicit lines)
monster book window: ja uses up to 5 lines of 20
_doc_patterns: patterns: [lo, hi, regex, N, max_lines, note] -- checked before 'ranges'; a Japanese string in [lo,hi) matching regex (re.match) uses this window width/lines.
patterns: item stat block (target/range/effect rows of two 10-col fields; ja uses up to 3-4 rows)
item screen effect field / stat block: 20 columns (two 10-col fields), 2 lines (verified: effect line in item menu)
